indicator_name: Import price indices by HS section, month vs December of the previous year
description: Индексы цен импорта по разделам ТН ВЭД, отчётный месяц к декабрю прошлого года
unit: index, December of the previous year = 100
methodology: Taldau 19073959, monthly from 2020-01. Items = HS sections I-XXI (roman numerals as dictionaries/hs_sections.csv; XXI from 2024) and TOTAL. Month-on-month = I(t)/I(t-1) within a year, January = I(Jan). Laspeyres, CIF, customs duties excluded, in tenge (BNS methodology). Consumer goods: IV (prepared food), XI (textiles, clothing), XII (footwear), XVI (appliances), XVII (cars), VI (pharmaceuticals, with chemicals).
